resources.string: Scan the QR code of a network, made with n3n-qr or shown by another phone, or write its configuration.
The configuration needs an address of this phone in the network: address = 10.1.2.3/24 in [tuntap].

The configuration, as in a .conf file of n3n:

[community]
name = mynetwork
key = mysecret
supernode = sn.example.org:7654

[tuntap]
address = 10.1.2.3/24
Each device needs an address of its own in the network: address = … in [tuntap]. Saved when you leave this screen; a running connection takes it on the next connect.
Saved: connect again to use it
Point the camera at the QR code of the configuration
No QR code found in that image
That QR code holds no n3n configuration
Replace the configuration with the one from the QR code?
If this is a protected n3n configuration, enter its PIN.
Not the right PIN, or no n3n code
The code holds this phone\'s address %1$s: the device that scans it has to change it to one of its own.
The device that scans it adds an address of its own (or lets the supernode assign one, where it can).
The code then shows neither the configuration nor that it is n3n\'s. Tell the PIN separately. A short PIN keeps a code from saying what it is at a glance; it is no strong protection.
Scan with the n3n app. The code holds the configuration as it is, key included: show it only to who may join.
Protected with a PIN. Scan with the n3n app, then enter the PIN.
The configuration does not fit into a QR code
